caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented object that appears to be a glass lamp or decorative vessel with an ornate design. The main body of the object is bulbous and tapers downward, featuring elongated, oval-shaped panels separated by slightly raised vertical lines, with rounded embellishments encircling the upper portion. The neck transitions into a narrower, columnar section with geometric and rounded elements layered above a square-shaped, flared base that provides stability. The top of the object includes a metallic screw-cap or fitting, shown in a darker shade, suggesting the presence of an opening or attachment point. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray with subtle yellowish-brown highlights, giving the appearance of transparent or reflective glass. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background with minimal markings and faint lines, and there is a small handwritten signature in the lower left corner.
title: Lamp
